affiliate_clicks_target_ref_chk.name: affiliate_clicks_target_ref_chk
affiliate_clicks_target_ref_chk.value:
("affiliate_clicks"."target_kind" = 'offer' and "affiliate_clicks"."deal_id" is null)
          or ("affiliate_clicks"."target_kind" = 'deal' and "affiliate_clicks"."offer_id" is null)

deals_destination_en_len_chk.name: deals_destination_en_len_chk
deals_destination_en_len_chk.value: "deals"."destination_en" is null or char_length("deals"."destination_en") between 2 and 60

deals_airline_en_len_chk.name: deals_airline_en_len_chk
deals_airline_en_len_chk.value: "deals"."airline_en" is null or char_length("deals"."airline_en") between 2 and 60

deals_travel_window_chk.name: deals_travel_window_chk
deals_travel_window_chk.value: "deals"."travel_to" is null or "deals"."travel_from" is null or "deals"."travel_to" >= "deals"."travel_from"
